MarginTop.helper: Space outside the section, above it.

PaddingTop.helper: Space inside the section, above the content.

PaddingBottom.helper: Space inside the section, below the content.

MarginBottom.helper: Space outside the section, below it.

AutoForward.rightLabel: Automatically advance one card every 5 seconds
AutoForward.helper: Rotation pauses on hover and keyboard focus, and visitors get a Pause/Play button. It starts paused for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

ShowNavigation.helper: Adds left and right buttons that move the cards one at a time. Buttons are hidden automatically when all cards already fit on screen.
